licoes.objectivo: Falar dos pontos fortes e dos gostos com good at + -ing, enjoy + -ing e want / would like + to, com um exemplo.

exercicios.frase: I'd love [to apply] for this job.

exercicios.enunciado: Choose the best answer about a weakness.

opcoes.texto: I'm not very good at writing reports, but I'm doing a course.

exercicios.enunciado: Why do you give an example after a strength?

exercicios.frase: I'm not very good at writing reports. But I'm doing a course on Saturdays, and I want to improve.
exercicios.enunciado: What is Nuno not very good at?
What are you good at? Give one example.
exercicios.resposta: I'm good at organising things. For example, last year I organised a conference for two hundred people.
exercicios.contexto: Um ponto forte e um exemplo no passado.

exercicios.enunciado: What are you not very good at? What are you doing about it?
exercicios.resposta: I'm not very good at speaking in meetings, but I'm practising with my English tutor every week.
exercicios.contexto: Honestidade e o que está a fazer.

licoes.objectivo: Dizer como se faz uma coisa com advérbios de modo e distinguir good / well.

exercicios.frase: Well, he works hard, and he learns very quickly.
exercicios.enunciado: Paulo is talking about Nuno. How does Nuno learn?

exercicios.frase: He checks everything carefully. He speaks English well.

exercicios.enunciado: Describe how a colleague works. Use two adverbs.
exercicios.resposta: My colleague Joana works hard. She speaks to clients politely, and she explains things clearly.

exercicios.enunciado: How do you speak English now? Compare with last year.
exercicios.resposta: I speak English much better now. I still speak slowly, but I understand people well.
exercicios.contexto: Use better, well e um advérbio em -ly.

licoes.titulo: What have you done? What will you do?
licoes.objectivo: Responder às perguntas de uma entrevista, escolhendo o tempo certo.

exercicios.frase: In five years, I want [to be] a network engineer.

exercicios.enunciado: "How long have you worked there?" Choose the best answer.

opcoes.texto: I've worked there for two years.
I work there for two years.
I worked there since two years.

exercicios.enunciado: "Tell me about a difficult situation." Choose the correct start.

opcoes.texto: Last year I had a big problem with a client.
Last year I have a big problem with a client.
Last year I've had a big problem with a client.

exercicios.enunciado: "Where do you see yourself in five years?" Choose the best answer.

opcoes.texto: I want to be a manager.

exercicios.enunciado: "What have you learned in this job?" Choose the correct answer.

opcoes.texto: I've learned to work with clients.
I learn to work with clients yesterday.
I've learned to work with clients last year.

exercicios.frase: I want to be a network engineer. I'm going to finish my English course this year.
exercicios.enunciado: What does Nuno want to be?

exercicios.frase: I've worked at Kalandula Tech since October. Before that, I did an internship there for three months.
I've worked there since October. Before that, I did an internship.
exercicios.enunciado: Ouça e repita, com uma pausa curta antes de "Before that".
What do you do at the moment, and how long have you done it?
exercicios.resposta: I'm an accountant at a bank. I've worked there since 2022. These days I'm working on the end-of-year reports.
exercicios.contexto: Presente e present perfect com since / for.

exercicios.enunciado: Where do you see yourself in five years?
exercicios.resposta: I want to be a finance manager. I'm going to do a course next year, and I think I'll speak English very well.
exercicios.contexto: want to, going to e will.

licoes.objectivo: Usar as palavras de competências e candidaturas, com o acento certo em -tion e -ity; realise e sensible.

opcoes.texto: a letter or a form to ask for a job
the money you get for a job

exercicios.enunciado: "Realizámos o projecto em seis meses." Em inglês:

opcoes.texto: We did the project in six months.
We realised the project in six months.
We realized the project in six months.

exercicios.frase: I'd like to apply [for] the position.
There's training in Johannesburg, and they'll talk about the salary at the interview.
I have good communication skills and a lot of responsibility.

exercicios.enunciado: What are your three best skills?
exercicios.resposta: My best skills are communication, teamwork and problem-solving.

exercicios.enunciado: Do you have experience with clients? Tell me.
exercicios.resposta: Yes, I have experience with clients. I've worked with them for three years, first in a shop and then in a bank.

licoes.titulo: Real English: Why do you want this job?
licoes.objectivo: Identificar a experiência, as qualidades e o objectivo de três candidatos.

exercicios.frase: I've taught English at a secondary school in Malanje for twelve years, and I love teaching.
exercicios.enunciado: How long has Esperança taught in Malanje?

exercicios.frase: I've already given some evening classes to bank staff, and I enjoyed it very much.
exercicios.enunciado: Who has Esperança taught in the evenings?

exercicios.frase: It's a good job, but last year my wife and I had a baby, and I want to be at home every night.
exercicios.enunciado: Why does Kevin want a new job?

opcoes.texto: He wants to be at home every night.

exercicios.frase: I want to stay in Angola — my wife is Angolan, and we're going to live in Luanda.
exercicios.enunciado: Where is Kevin going to live?

exercicios.frase: I speak French, Lingala and English, and I'm learning Portuguese.
In the future, I'd like to manage a team.

opcoes.texto: experience, a quality and a goal
a long story about the family

exercicios.frase: I'm good at explaining grammar in a simple way.
exercicios.enunciado: Ouça e repita em voz alta.
Imagine an interview for your dream job. Why do you want this job?
exercicios.resposta: I've worked in sales for five years. I'm good at talking to people, and I'm reliable. My goal is to manage a sales team.
exercicios.contexto: Experiência, uma qualidade e um objectivo.

exercicios.enunciado: What's your goal for the future?
exercicios.resposta: I'd like to work for an international company and travel for work.
exercicios.contexto: I'd like to / I want to.

licoes.objectivo: Fazer uma entrevista simples e explicar em inglês uma carta escrita em português.

exercicios.enunciado: "Tell me about yourself." Choose the best start.

opcoes.texto: I was born in Benguela, and I studied economics there. I've worked at a bank since 2021.

exercicios.enunciado: "Why do you want this position?" Choose the best answer.

opcoes.texto: I enjoy working with clients, and I'd like to learn more.

exercicios.frase: Could you tell me [more] about the training?

exercicios.enunciado: "Do you have any questions for us?" Choose the best answer.

opcoes.texto: Yes. Could you tell me more about the training?
Yes. When can I stop working?

exercicios.enunciado: The letter says: "aprende depressa". Nuno says:

exercicios.frase: The training is two weeks in July. And we'll call all the candidates next Friday.
exercicios.enunciado: When will Lerato call the candidates?

exercicios.frase: My writing in English is slower than my speaking. But I've started a course, and I already write my reports faster.

exercicios.enunciado: Pode falar-me mais sobre a formação?
exercicios.resposta: Could you tell me more about the training?

exercicios.frase: Thank you very much. It was a pleasure.
exercicios.enunciado: Ouça e repita, com voz calma e clara.

exercicios.resposta: I was born in Huambo, and I studied engineering in Luanda. I've worked at an oil company since 2020. These days I'm working on a new project.

exercicios.enunciado: Do you have any questions for us? Ask two.
exercicios.resposta: Yes, two. Could you tell me more about the team? And when will I know your decision?

licoes.objectivo: Rever a unidade 10 e reciclar as unidades 2, 6, 8 e 9.

exercicios.frase: Last year, I [did] a course in management.

exercicios.enunciado: Reciclagem (A2, unidade 9). Choose the correct sentence.

opcoes.texto: Could you send me the report, please?
Could you to send me the report, please?
Could you sending me the report, please?

exercicios.enunciado: Reciclagem (A2, unidade 8). Choose the correct sentence.

opcoes.texto: If I get the job, I'll move to Luanda.
If I'll get the job, I move to Luanda.
If I get the job, I moved to Luanda.

exercicios.enunciado: Reciclagem (A2, unidade 6). Choose the correct sentence.

opcoes.texto: Have you ever worked in a team?
Did you ever worked in a team?
Have you ever work in a team?

exercicios.enunciado: Reciclagem (A2, unidade 2). Choose the correct sentence.

opcoes.texto: I was working when the power went off.
I was work when the power went off.
I working when the power went off.

exercicios.resposta: I work well in a team.

exercicios.frase: I'm a reliable engineer, and I work well in a team.
exercicios.enunciado: What does Kevin say about himself?

opcoes.texto: He works well in a team.

exercicios.enunciado: Tell me about one of your strengths, with an example.
exercicios.resposta: I'm good at solving problems. For example, last month our system stopped, and I found the problem in one hour.

exercicios.enunciado: Describe a colleague: how does he or she work?
exercicios.resposta: My colleague Paulo works hard. He speaks to clients politely, and he checks everything carefully.
